title: Naesia's silky vocals add a new dimension to M3DZ's "HUHH?!"
htmlContent:
London-based production duo M3DZ has dropped their highly anticipated single "HUHH?!" with the perfect addition of singer/songwriter Naesia's vocals. The track's hard-hitting, rhythmic drums paired with heavy basses and deep Jazz chords create a chilled and spacey vibe that encapsulates the duo's sound. 

M3DZ displays their exceptional beat-making abilities, each performing an impressive rap section with sophisticated lyrics and refined flows. Adding Naesia's silky vocals creates a tangible contrast to the male rap sections, enhancing the track's overall feel.

Naesia's unique sound, blending R&B, Trap, Neo-Soul, and Jazz, has taken inspiration from artists like Jhené Aiko, Kehlani, Brent Faiyaz, H.E.R., Lauryn Hill, Erykah Badu, and Frank Ocean. The German-born singer/songwriter moved to London in 2018 to study music and pursue her career. 

The 23-year-old surprises listeners with smooth vocals and alluring harmonies while aiming to create her style. "HUHH?!" showcases her versatility, and it is a perfect addition to the track's happy and sexy moods.
